title: What is Async Storage?
overview: Async Storage is a local storage solution in React Native that allows applications to store small amounts of data on the user's device. The stored data remains available even after closing and reopening the application.

example.title: Common Uses
example.content:
Async Storage is used for:
• Saving user preferences
• Storing login information
• Keeping app settings
• Saving temporary data

title: Installing Async Storage
overview: Async Storage is provided as a separate community package in React Native. It needs to be installed before using it inside an application.

title: Storing Data with Async Storage
overview: The setItem method is used to store data in Async Storage. Data is stored in key-value format and values must be saved as strings.

title: Getting Data from Async Storage
overview: The getItem method is used to retrieve stored data from Async Storage. It returns the stored value using the provided key.

title: Updating and Removing Data
overview: Async Storage allows updating existing values by using setItem again with the same key. Data can also be removed using the removeItem method.

example.title: Update and Remove

title: Storing Objects and Arrays
overview: Async Storage only stores strings, so objects and arrays need to be converted into JSON format before saving and converted back after retrieving.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Async Storage works, how to install it, store and retrieve data, update and remove values, and handle objects and arrays using JSON conversion.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Async Storage stores local data.
✔ Data is stored as key-value pairs.
✔ setItem saves data.
✔ getItem retrieves data.
✔ JSON.stringify and JSON.parse handle objects.
